answer.value: Assembly Line A shows more balanced distribution across distribution centers with flows to East China DC (195), South China DC (155), and North America DC (120), while Assembly Line B has lower total volume and more concentrated distribution

key_insights: Assembly Line A has higher total outflow at 470 vs Assembly Line B at 330
Assembly Line A distributes to 3 DCs while Assembly Line B only to 2
